title: Polychlorinated Biphenyls - A Forgotten Legacy?

sections.heading: Body
sections.text:
PCB, or polychlorinated biphenyls, are chemicals that have dangerous effects on the environment and human health. PCB have been used in many industrial applications such as transformers and capacitors. Although they are no longer allowed to be produced, they can still be found everywhere around us.
